approved.name: MinFWVer
approved.description: Checks the minimum factory firmware version of your PS Vita.
approved.long_description: Utility for checking the factory firmware version of a PS Vita. Published by Electric1447; the factory firmware code is credited to TheFloW in the original README.
approved.requirements: - Homebrew-enabled PS Vita with Unsafe Homebrew enabled.
